explanation: States the explicit two-sided bound 2^{n²/16 + αn log₂ n} ≤ f(n) ≤ 2^{n²/16 + βn^{3/2}} for all n > 1, attributed to [RoTr25, Theorem 1]. The arXiv abstract only states the 2^{n²/16+o(n²)} form, so I could not verify these exact error terms. The statement is well formed and consistent with the abstract, and it implies the asymptotic variant.
